title: Regino of Prüm
fact_summary: A Frankish abbot and chronicler (about 840–915). His chronicle, finished in 906, records the Hungarians' arrival in the West.

claims.text: The Mapping Medieval Peoples database gives his dates as 840 to 915 and describes him as “Abbot of Prüm and St Martin's Trier, Chronicler”.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the database record says, read in the open copy linked under Sources.

claims.text: It says his chronicle “was finished in 906 and dedicated to Bishop Adalbero of Augsburg in 908”, and that its place of writing is uncertain.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the database record says, read in the open copy linked under Sources.

claims.text: His chronicle was continued from 907 to 967 by another writer at Trier, whom its editor identifies as Adalbert, later archbishop of Magdeburg.
claims.certainty_reason: This records what the editor's preface says, read in Latin in the scanned edition linked under Sources.

open_questions.text: Where did Regino get his information about the Hungarians and the Pechenegs?
